climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
building_stock: The only door-specific evidence from Altona North is a resident's own Airtasker lock-installation request to fit a slim smart lock to an existing aluminium door frame with a glazed window panel, requiring drilling — so the installation problem here is narrow-stile aluminium and glass entry doors rather than standard timber slabs; local providers also list apartment doors and office doors alongside house doors (altonanorthlocksmiths.com.au) and describe the suburb as mixed residential and commercial (toplocksmithmelbourne.com.au Altona North page).
council_notes: No heritage-overlay, body-corporate or owners-corporation signals appeared in the returned records; the one regulatory consideration actually evidenced is licensing — the Altona North resident's Airtasker brief explicitly stipulated a 'licensed locksmith' with a documented history of that specific install type before they would accept the job.
demographic_skew: Signals point to a split of owner-occupiers, tenants and landlords with investment properties — the Altona locksmith page addressing this area speaks to 'homeowner, tenant or a landlord' and to rekeying existing locks when moving in (24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au) — alongside price-conscious buyers (kollioulocksmiths.com.au leads its Altona North page on affordability) and a visible do-it-yourself-procurement habit of buying the smart lock online and hiring an installer separately via Airtasker, where 11 locksmiths compete on 9 reviews.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be fitted to an aluminium door frame with a glazed window panel, and whether drilling the existing door is unavoidable — the exact brief posted by an Altona North resident on Airtasker's lock-installation page.

Whether the installer is licensed and has actually installed that model before, not just locks in general — the same Airtasker brief made 'licensed locksmith with history of these types of install' a condition of hiring.
Whether a locksmith will install a customer-supplied smart lock bought online (the Altona North job named a slim smart lock from smartdoorlocks.com.au) rather than only hardware the locksmith sells.

Cost of upgrading, with residents weighing security against price — kollioulocksmiths.com.au frames its Altona North offer around locks being 'very affordable because we understand that security shouldn't be something you go without based on price', and altonanorthlocksmiths.com.au competes on 'the most affordable price'.
